Employees who contribute to the sales activity (opportunity management and prospecting plan) can make two types of Salesforce rights requests:
Request for access rights (or licenses): These rights define the type of account the employee has and the standard rights they will have on Salesforce.
Request for advanced rights (or permissions): Specific data access rights (export, Excel/Power BI, report editing, and dashboards) that need to be granted for specific assignments.
This procedure is for user access requests. It allows you to give access to Salesforce to employees who do not have access or want to change their type of access to Salesforce.
Important!
Requests for rights can
only be made via the request form on Waveplace
. If a user makes a ticket to request a Salesforce account without using the form, please send him/her to the rights request form
https: //digiplace.sharepoint.com/sites/online-forms/rights-request-management/Pages/Forms.aspx

In case of an urgent request to activate the account before the Salesforce training, the request must be escalated to the N3 to validate the opening in advance. In all cases, the new user will be required to complete the Salesforce training.

4- Verify that the user is only in one Salesforce group

You have to check that the user is only in one Salesforce security group in the AD, the one associated with his application. This is an important step because if the user is part of two groups, it will create a conflict and the user will not have the requested license. The ticket will therefore not be processed.
The synchronization that applies the change in Salesforce takes about four hours.
Before continuing with step 5, please wait for the sync to complete.

Entitlement requests are
only made via the request form on Waveplace
. If a user makes a ticket to request a Salesforce account without going through the form, refer them to the rights request form
https: //digiplace.sharepoint.com/sites/online-forms/rights-request-management/Pages/Forms.aspx

In case of an urgent request to activate the account before the Salesforce training, the request must be escalated to the N3 to validate the opening in advance. In all cases, the new user will be required to complete the Salesforce training.

If you make a license change, it will cause the rights (permission sets) to be removed. Remember to look at and write down the permission sets assigned on the profile before you make the license changes so that you can put them back after the changes. If this step was forgotten, escalate the ticket to group
N3 - IT > SELL
with a comment: "The user's advanced rights have been disabled and I forgot to note them down to re-enable them, please re-enable them".
If the user does not belong to any group then escalate the ticket to group
N3 - IT > SELL
with a comment: "The user is not present in any security group".
For any other problem, escalate the ticket to group
N3 - IT > SELL
with the appropriate comment.
